label: With POTENCY_1 (adopted), nothing moves itself in the same respect
meaning: POTENCY_1 (ADOPTED) branch of the prima via step: what is moved in a respect is not in act in it (adopted potency), and what moves in a respect is in act in it; so nothing moves itself in the respect in which it is moved. No non-simultaneity premise is needed: the ADOPTED definition contains it. The controls show each of the two premises is needed.

strong_version_needed.bc4051e9-7098-56f2-8204-e998c5be653b: The ADOPTED branch needs the not-in-act conjunct of adopted potency: it replaces the non-simultaneity premise. The weaker STMT-MOVED-ONLY-AS-CAPABLE gives the conclusion only with the CAPACITY non-simultaneity premise (NO-SELF-MOTION-FROM-CAPACITY), which is refuted under STMT-SOME-CAPACITY-EXERCISED; the omission control in TERM-SENSE-FORKS-3-CONTROLS shows the branch fails without its moved premise.
